description: Run well pumps, center pivots, drip zones, fertigation injection, and freeze-protection overhead irrigation to schedule; monitor flow and pressure
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Sandy soils: drip-irrigated strawberries and vegetables show stress within about a day without water in spring heat; freeze-protection nights (December to February) need the overhead system running within 1 hour of the trigger temperature or the strawberry crop is lost (up to about $360,000); fertigation that runs at the wrong rate can burn plants or exceed permit and label limits; water use must stay within the permit (flow records); RPO of 24 h covers schedules and setpoints, and the PLC program must be restorable to its last approved version
source_evidence: EV-047 (Farm Manager and Irrigation Technician interviews); EV-037 (receipts); EV-023 (backup schedule); EV-014 (PLC program copies)
manual_workaround: Irrigation Technician runs pumps and pivots by hand at each panel (Hand-Off-Auto); fertigation stopped until automation is verified; freeze nights staffed by two people on site; flow read from meter faces and logged on paper
dependent_systems: SYS-07 (PLC; HMI; pivot panels; valve controllers; probes); SYS-01 irrigation module; SYS-05; SYS-04 data hub
dependent_third_parties: FMIS vendor; irrigation integrator; electric utility; cellular carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Irrigation Technician; Farm Manager; pump house; North Block pivots

description: Assign crews; record piece-rate field tally per worker; pack and lot-code produce; harvest and packing records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Strawberries must be picked every 2 to 3 days in season and cannot wait; field tally is the H-2A earnings record (20 CFR 655.122(j)) and the basis of piece-rate pay; Produce Safety harvest records must be created at the time of the activity (21 CFR 112.161(a)(2)); in-season receipts are about $7,500 per day
source_evidence: EV-047 (Farm Manager interview); EV-037 (receipts); EV-038 (tally and payroll)
manual_workaround: Paper tally cards signed by crew leads and entered later; pre-printed lot code labels; paper packing log
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (harvest tally; lot codes); SYS-06 tablets; SYS-02
dependent_people_or_facilities: Crew Leads; farm workers; Food Safety and Packing Lead; packing shed

description: Hold packed produce in the cooler; temperature alarms; temperature logs for buyers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Strawberries lose shelf life within hours above target temperature; a full cooler holds about $25,000 to $45,000 of product in peak season; the distributor asks for temperature logs with each load
source_evidence: EV-047 (Food Safety and Packing Lead interview); EV-043 (cooler alarm service)
manual_workaround: Hourly manual thermometer checks with a paper log; on-call phone rotation; move product to the distributor early
dependent_systems: SYS-07 cooler sensors and alarm service; SYS-05
dependent_third_parties: Alarm service vendor; refrigeration contractor; electric utility
dependent_people_or_facilities: Food Safety and Packing Lead; cooler

description: Distributor orders; bills of lading; invoices; peanut deliveries to the buying point
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Distributor places orders daily in season; peanut settlements come from the buying point, which keeps its own records; missed loads cost about $5,000 to $15,000 each
source_evidence: EV-047 (Sales and Farm Stand Coordinator interview); EV-037 (receipts by channel)
manual_workaround: Orders by phone; handwritten bills of lading; invoice later from paper copies
dependent_people_or_facilities: Sales and Farm Stand Coordinator; Office and HR Manager

business_process: Direct sales (farm stand; online pre-orders; U-pick)
description: Card sales at the farm stand; online pre-orders with pickup; U-pick check-in
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekend sales in strawberry season are about $4,000 to $6,000 a day; card terminals are processor-managed on cellular; online orders need pickup lists
source_evidence: EV-047 (Sales and Farm Stand Coordinator interview); EV-037 (receipts by channel); EV-034 (card terminal service)
manual_workaround: Cash and processor's mobile card reader app; printed pickup list from the e-commerce vendor's mobile app
dependent_people_or_facilities: Sales and Farm Stand Coordinator; farm stand

business_process: Crop, application, and food safety records
description: Crop plans; scouting; fertilizer and pesticide application records; Produce Safety records (water; soil amendments; training; sanitation)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Produce Safety records must be retained 2 years and produced within 24 hours for off-site records on FDA request (21 CFR 112.164; 112.166); the GAP audit relies on the same records; distributor may suspend purchases if records cannot be shown
source_evidence: EV-047 (Food Safety and Packing Lead interview); EV-040 (record review sign-off)
manual_workaround: Paper forms kept in the packing shed binder; enter later
dependent_people_or_facilities: Food Safety and Packing Lead; Farm Manager

description: GNSS-guided planting, bed shaping, spraying, and variable-rate application; telematics
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Planting and spray windows are weather-driven; RTK correction and prescription maps needed for bed accuracy and section control; prescriptions change weekly
source_evidence: EV-047 (Equipment and Drone Specialist interview); EV-030 (telematics portal)
manual_workaround: Manual steering with foam or row markers at reduced speed; blanket-rate application; defer non-urgent operations

description: Weekly payroll; H-2A earnings statements; onboarding; terminations; personnel files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: H-2A workers must receive earnings statements on or before each payday (20 CFR 655.122(k)); earnings records must be kept 3 years and produced within 72 hours of a DOL request when kept at a central office (655.122(j)(2)); late pay harms workers and the farm's standing with the program
source_evidence: EV-047 (Office and HR Manager interview); EV-003 (HR roster); EV-038 (payroll register)
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior week's payroll through the payroll provider and correct next cycle; paper earnings statements from tally cards

business_process: Accounting; USDA program and crop insurance reporting
description: General ledger; bills; acreage reports; crop insurance production reports; NRCS contract documents
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Program and insurance deadlines are set by the agencies and the agent and fall at known points in the year; production evidence comes from buying point settlement sheets
source_evidence: EV-047 (Office and HR Manager interview); EV-036 (program documents)
manual_workaround: Pay urgent bills by bank portal; agent and agency offices accept paper
dependent_third_parties: CPA firm; crop insurance agent; USDA service center

description: Drone imagery flights; computer-vision yield estimates; crew and sales planning
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly planning cycle; estimates are advisory; the Farm Manager can plan from field counts as before the pilot
source_evidence: EV-047 (Farm Manager interview); EV-045 (AI tool use)
manual_workaround: Hand counts on sample plots (the pre-2025 method)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Equipment and Drone Specialist; Farm Manager
